topic: InfiMotion TL300: first mass-produced EV drive unit with magnesium-aluminum alloy housing. 109.5 kg for 340 kW dual motors.

next_draft.topic: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak RD#5 Caliber 8100: rack-and-pinion reset replaces heart cam, stores energy during timing and releases on reset. 0.3mm pusher travel, 300g force (10-25x less than conventional). Hybrid vertical-toothed clutch, six-armed reset lever, instantaneous jumping minute counter via truncated pinion, flying tourbillon, BMG palladium bezel. 31.4mm x 4.0mm movement in 39mm x 8.1mm Jumbo case. Patent EP4555385A1.
